name: NCAA D-I Mid-Atlantic Regional Cross Country Championships
headline: NCAA D-I Mid-Atlantic Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Men: No. 14 Georgetown and No. 17 Villanova. Women: No. 3 West Virginia, No. 24 Penn State and No. 29 Princeton. The top two teams and the top four individuals not on those teams qualify automatically for the NCAA Championships on Nov. 21. · Women 6K · Men 10K
